reason: I already have a drawer full of half-used bottles, so I am not paying $25 to $30 for another thing I might quit after a week. The sachet is handy when I travel, but 30 foil packets a month feels like a lot of trash.
objection: On my budget $29.99 a month is too much for a supplement I may not stick with, and every day's dose coming in its own foil packet is more waste.
would_change_my_mind: A small trial pack of about 7 sachets for around $9 to $10, so I can see if I even keep taking it before paying for a full month.
